title: Restore authoritative island boundary and completeness evidence for Falklands and SGSSI

body:
2026-10-05: Follow-up from #402. Independent boundary-source and completeness research only. Do not modify canonical geography, release pins, macro membership, or import/publish any geometry.

## Scope
For `FLK-5152` and `atlas:coverage:SGS+00?`, identify an authoritative, legally reusable boundary or island/rock inventory suitable for a declared map scale and minimum feature size. Reconcile FIG's published 778 smaller Falkland Islands count and the GSGSSI protected-features/island descriptions against a lawful source at comparable definitions. Verify source vintage, license, retrieval hash, territorial meaning, coverage omissions, and neighboring granularity. If authoritative raw GIS is not publicly reusable, record the source owner's restoration/access path and keep uncertainty explicit. Do not equate Natural Earth vertex counts or component counts with completeness.

Deliver a separate geography-owned evidence packet and exact reproduction. Recommendations for geometry changes are engineering handoffs only. Parent integration #401 remains responsible for combined regional review.

Acceptance: one reproducible, exact-source-hash packet; individually classified evidence for both subjects; explicit feature-size/definition and license findings; unresolved gaps and bounded engineering handoffs. One PR, maximum.
